description: Lore of named places and monsters from Living Server's lore bible, rewritten: sourced lines only, each said only in its own zone.

lines.text: Abermenai means the mouth of the Menai, old western tongue.
Abermenai renegade chieftain is 29. Ten levels on us.
A Troll father walked into Jordheim and said the Morvalt had Aegir, so Midgard sailed.
The Valkyn came ashore with us at Aegirhamn, the Morvalt the Troll fathers tamed.
Aegirhamn has masters of every house so the young need not sail home to train.
The Shale Golem Emissary came down to the haven to see what we were. He is still deciding.
The pyslings are the children the Morvalt took, still looking for home, the island folk say.
Catla Gardasdottir is not the first in Aegirhamn to want the mother's power, only the first to say so.
The boobries ate cattle in the old stories. Here they eat whatever they get.
The Musslaklan Trader will take Ibicus off your hands for tokens, Gazsi pays for them.
Rith and Torlieva only give tasks to folk the mussel clan has taken in.
Torlieva says she stands in a skalklan camp. The musslaklan say she stands in theirs.
Uger is the big quiet one at the north mussel camp.
Ibicus is a drake by the stone bridge north of Aegirhamn. Karle Alfevson wants him.
Catla Gardasdottir wants the mother of morvaltars magic. Her spirit is already sitting on a boulder outside Dyrfjall.
Mercer in Stoneleigh and Mercher in Old Sarum, same family, will not say which spelling is right.
Heard the ripleys and dinailaines got a lot in every village on the same day.
Heard Chiltern folk like being the quietest village.
Isle of Glass is the last bit Albion kept, the rest are behind the wall.
Seven isles: glass, Avalon, Aldland, Devwy, Caldey, Gwyddneau, Inishail.
Heard Gwyddneau is the only isle Albion never held.
Aldland is where the Krondon door is. Caer Diogel is the town.
Lammia sing on the west shore of Aldland. Do not listen.
Caer Diogel means the safe fort, heard.
Drakoran patrols walk the road near Caer Diogel now.
Heard there is a woman in black by the Caer Diogel stables at night.
Heard O'honat goes out west alone looking for a stone of Arawn's.
Curengkur is the fifth thing in Allta Fearann. The mantids only whisper its name.
The Krrzck only keep a waystation in Allta Fearann because Curengkur hunts them.
Do not say Curengkur out loud at the waystation. The mantids walk off.
The enraged arboreal spirits are the ones that remember being cut down, Necht says.
Five Drakoran clans in Avalon City, one lord each. And they took up the trades, like it was their city all along.
The guards on the way down to the Crystal Cave are called xanxicarian. Named after the dragon.
Five clans in Avalon City. Drau'gyn, dry'ak, syhr'phint, vyr'em, wi'voron. One lord each.
The drau'gyn keep the flamethrowers in Avalon. Dra'argus is their lord.
The Drakoran in Avalon have reeves and sutlers and joiners. Like a real city.
The wi'voron are the Drakoran cavalry. Weno'iak rides with them.
Heard the light that came up out of Avalon was Merlin's crystal.
Heard the light that came up out of Avalon was Xanxicar waking.
Avalon Isle is all orchards. The dead harvesters still pick apples that are not there.
Wearyall is the only village we hold on Avalon Isle.
The Avalon City door is in the middle of the isle.
The appletrees walk on Avalon Isle. Do not press their apples.
Sea hounds and water shucks run the southern sand.
The dry'ak clan holds the middle of the isle round the city.
Heard Tomos only shows up once Nalsor is dead.
Heard Barak's pendant is why our protection spells keep failing.
Heard the dead court of Caer Caddug and Prios's ghosts will not cross each other.
Avalon Marsh is the drowned country west of Campacorentin.
Caer Witrin means fort of glass, heard.
The lady of the lake walks the meres at night. Not every night.
The bogmen fight anyone who walks into their reeds.
Heard Fiedel walked out of the grave before his lord did.
Heard Dooben the mud golem glows when he is resting.
Heard Vagdush roots you and curses you if you stay at range. Get in his face.
Heard the Marsh Lord never starts a fight. Walk past it.
Ghost miners walk up the hill north of Snowdonia station at night.
Mathien at the station leaves his stable open at night. Ask him why.
Black Mtns north is the road to Snowdonia and the frontier.
Heard Ulfwag sleeps with his head on half a book.
Heard Sergeant Cosworth would rather be dead than relieved. Well.
Black mountain blades are Gundron McCory's lot. Robbers near Ludlow.
Heard the Great Gobzini does magic tricks for goblins at the mine door.
Heard Shaman Aslis talks to the dead and her skeletons drop when she does.
Heard Sacrificer Harish gets up again as a shade when you kill him.
Heard Frund and Agisthil were our guards. They ran with stones.
Heard the Goblin Storm Shaman is why Ludlow has wet harvests.
Heard the nain Dwarves in the west woods do not like the red Dwarves either.
Heard Aldous Wynedd has a cloak of shades.
Manius is the outlaws' Druid. Fruadan draoi.
The aughisky are water horses. Never ride a horse standing at the water's edge.
There is a shrieking tree in the south of the bog. Last heir quest.
The cronicorns near the queen are 68. Two of them.
A bananach shrieks over the north field at night. Battle spirit.
The Marfach entrance is in east Breifine past Dun Crimthain.
The spectral manslayers in the north are 50-53. Tough.
The Inconnu guide you through Caer Sidi but they will not go past the four riders. Not their place.
Farmers found cursed seeds in Cothrom Gorge. One got lost and grew into Feairna-athar.
Lilerbad will not say what the tapestry is. I have asked.
Goby fishes in the rivers with the gobblers. 22.
Caldey was where Avalon buried it is dead. That is why it is all undead.
A highland clan came to Caldey to fight the dead. Their outpost is next to little haven.
Little haven pays for undead parts. Rose wants shrouds, Tristram wants shin bones.
Eralyne was a young sorceress buried by the Caer Sidi door. Now she is up.
Telsar on Caldey is a jelly that never hurt anyone. Leave it alone.
Heard the Amphiptere is older than any grave on Caldey.
Heard Telsar was on Caldey before the graves.
The chieftess Caledon is the strongest renegade lord of the four fields. Her casters see far.
The renegades in Caer Caledon are from every realm. Armsmen, huscarls, a ranger.
The renegades of Caledon fought the headhunters back north. Only time renegades fought for our dead.
Heard the chieftess in Caer Caledon was an Alb Armswoman once.
The Arawnite headhunters in the far north still take heads, supposedly.
Camelot Hills is where every Alb starts. Cotswold or Prydwen, depends who you ask.
The spriggarns say they carved the stone head on the hill. Or found it.
Lady Nimue by the water north of the stables gives out the best low level quests in Albion.
Brother Codeth at the bridge keeps a journal on the Mithra cult. Read it before you go down.
Heard Cronker the toad is only there in the mornings. The rest of the day he is just gone.
Heard Cilydd Difwych has a box he cannot open. Took it off a courier.
The trainers in Camelot stand in pairs. Church classes by the bishop, Wizards by the library.
The Realm Exchange in Camelot has no fee. The merchants hate it.
Sister Elaydith's quests all end up in Darkness Falls somehow.
The masters of Armsman in Camelot are still sending people after Excalibur.
Master Vismer in Camelot wants to know who raises the dead. Do not ask how he finds out.
Sister Elaydith knows about a box with papers Arthur wrote himself, heard.
Heard the plague that burns your back came up from Darkness Falls.
Heard lord Aryon's box is warded and the key got stolen from his grave.
Heard the lady of the lake knows where Excalibur is and will not say.
Campacorentin is the oldest wood in Albion. The oak for Camelot came from here.
The ghostly knights east of Caer Ulfwych died in some old war and stayed.
The verderers say the grove counts every tree we cut and will want them back.
Heard Ciraron Webweaver hardly ever comes out. Camp the bloated spiders.
Heard Granddaddy Longlegs is rare too, just north of the fogou.
Heard Urfgrat the Green is the only goblin the ogres listen to.
Heard the Oaken Knight keeps the road edge like a bridge.
Heard Ormgarth walks with a dozen snakes. Never pull him solo.
Heard the Green Witch has a box that might say where Merlin went.
Cardova holds a Roman emperor nobody can name. Cornwall is a strange place to bury an emperor.
The coins in Cardova have the face beaten flat. The Romans did that to people they wanted forgotten.
Seleucus took the chair when the first emperor died. His four generals swore to him for life and after.
Olivarius Taras Crotus Amminus. The four who kept the oath too well.
The long hall in Cardova has a heated floor like a Roman bath. Still warm.
The Spirit of the Emperor in Cardova is peaceful. It just talks.
The Forgotten Emperor carries a staff Vismer wants. Arc of ages.
Heard the Forgotten Emperor is the real one and Seleucus sat in his seat.
Heard the Cardova floor smokes down the middle of the long hall. Walk the walls.
Heard there is a back door out of Cardova at the bottom by Amminus.
Tir Urphost covers every lamp on the cliff path at night because of Tawi Shon.
Druid Tobryn sends the young into the Koalinth caves for his broken seal.
Ceard the smith wandered the beach past the fogs and never said what he saw.
Brother Esras keeps a hermitage on the southern cliffs.
Someone fell off the Cliffs of Moher again. Long way down.
Word is the cliff dwellers raided a tir Urphost boat on the strand.
The Fanged Sinach is out in the shallows at the bottom of the cliffs. 43.
Tie a rope on in the fog on the cliff top. Tir Urphost custom.
Heard the Grey Man of Moher is a cliff dweller. Not the fog kind.
Heard the gales on Moher carry vervain from some Druid's garden.
Ardee is the town of the ford. Some hero killed his foster brother there in the old tales.
Every trainer in Tir na Nog sends you to Maeve the crone first. Rat tails.
The Amadan Dubh is the dark fool. His touch drives you mad. The touched.
House Findias is named after one of the cities the old gods came from, the Bards say.
The cluricauns in the west have an enchantress who trades soul gems.
Word is Chieftain Ultan is guarding house Findias. The speaker will not say from what.
Heard the Elder Tidal Sheerie knows more about the azure than it says.
Maeve the crone wants rat tails again. Always.
Heard Dorbal was the first herder the Amadan ever touched. Do not laugh back.
Heard Pikebane the bear ate every pike in the Basar river in one summer.
Heard Rathil O'Carolan got elfshot crossing a fairy ring and cannot finish a tune since.
Heard Chieftain Ultan says he guards house Findias. His follower decides where they go.
Heard the Follower of Ultan never says a word. Ultan does all the talking.
Heard Daewain the toad only shows when somebody walks onto the bridge south-west of Basar.
Heard Juliy the Jester came to make the Amadan laugh. It worked. Too well.
Heard the Lucan by the Muire stones is the bit of Lucan that did not want to rest.
The Cardova door is in the ring of stones in south Cornwall.
Cornwall drakes nest on the western cliffs over the sea that ate Lyonesse.
Bucca used to be sea spirits. Now they just sit by streams.
Heard Aricoer has souls shut up in his broken keep. You can hear them from the road.
Heard Cirfans has a heart the Lethantis lot want and they will not say why.
Heard the young Cornwall drakes come back with salt on their wings.
Heard a station lad went up after Kalnraw. Kalnraw was still there in autumn.
The unseelie run Coruscating Mine with slaves. Geas, collars, the lot.
There is true silver in Coruscating. They say Nuada's hand came from there.
The collared workers in the mine were farmers once. The unseelie took them.
The Overseer of the Silver Hand has three guardians with him. Four fifties.
Lobigan keeps the far end of the vein in Coruscating. Where it ends or starts.
The silver in Coruscating rings when nobody hits it, the Howth men say.
Heard the unseelie keep Nuada's silver hand at the bottom of Coruscating Mine.
Word is the vein golems are made of the seam.
Heard the collared miners call each Guardian of the Silver Hand a finger of it.
The worts are all one plant, the outlanders say. Runners of Marfoirwort.
The rot came up through the gorge from under worlds end.
Altan Garran is built around Treal, an old treant who walked back from the edge.
Aodhnait in Altan Garran is a Lough Derg spear who lost her company in the gorge.
Feairna-athar is a cursed treant grown from the lost seed. South west gorge.
Run from the laughter before you know what it is. Gorge custom.
The devil rays in the north west are 60-64. Do not fly too close.
Heard the worts are closer to Altan Garran every summer.
Treal buried another root. Writhing death done.
The Cruachan hill at the head of the gorge was a queen's seat and a door to the Otherworld in the songs.
A rainbow over Cruachan is just a crowd of rainbow sprites in a good mood.
The Darkness Falls stair is right beside Dun Lamfhota.
The spear is not ours because we hold it, we hold it because its ours. First chieftain of Lamfhota.
Heard the spear is under attack at Dun Lamfhota. Defend.
Heard Xanxicar grew the crystal. Or the crystal grew him.
Heard the guards in the Crystal Cave are worse than the dragon.
Heard Xanxicar wiped five full groups in one go.
Heard a five group wipe on Xanxicar was still news in 2005.
The Faerie Queen kept half a moonstone and could not take it back across the veil.
Cursed leprechauns are 63. Not funny.
The Cursed Tomb is where Midgard puts the dead the gods would not take. Deserters, oathbreakers, bad kings.
The draugr in the Cursed Tomb still drill under their commander. Dead and still drilling.
You take the dead into the Cursed Tomb at night with no torches, so the gods do not look.
The trapped thralls were buried with their masters. Still down there.
The mora in the deep crypt are night riders. They sit on sleepers chests.
Bevard was a reeve once. Still keeps an eye on the priestess.
Haggert is the oldest hagbui in the tomb anyone has named.
Myrkwood wants the Tomb Priestess put down. Her dead have started getting out.
The Dread Lichess in the Cursed Tomb was a queen once, they say. Nobody says whose.
The kings halls rats are the size of dogs. Mad rats.
Troika is three dead in one grave because nobody would pay for three.
The Draugr Commander gave the order to run and drills it out of them still.
The ghost families in Devwy do not know they are dead. They still keep house.
Juliana Grym asks if somethings wrong. It is.
The Meical in that hall is a Drakoran wearing a dead master's name, heard.
Fort Gwyntell is on the hill where they winnowed grain, Gwyntell is the wind word.
The Priest of Arawn in Gwyntell says the Drakoran Necromancers keep the ghosts in their houses.
The Drakoran camp in Devwy is bigger than the fort. Over a hundred guardsmen.
The apple gatherers near Gwyntell still pick apples nobody eats.
Heard Gracien keeps a second book with the ghost families' names.
Kill all the princes in Darkness Falls and the tunnels shake. The worm comes up.
Mutilator Xagalith has the most honest title in the whole of Darkness Falls.
Moran the Mighty keeps the high ground in Dartmoor. The wind does what he says.
The old tinners left the knockers a crust of bread. The knockers got meaner when the tinners left.
Heard two dozen good people can kill Golestandt now. Takes hours though.
Heard the burnt line in Dartmoor moves north a bit every year.
Someone said the Dartmoor ponies are the giants' flock. Never seen a giant hurt one.
Dellingstad is its own peoples town, not midgards.
Weaponmaster Zargin teaches dellingstads young with golems of straw.
The klippa Vaktaren are cliff watchers who fly bonded griffons.
The yellow bones on the caldera floor are people who interrupted the elements.
Khrin the old sabre cat watches the Morvalt hunters camp.
The griffmen elders are older than dellingstad.
Dellingstad fishwives cut ice off the glacier for the fish.
The innocents at the door of Dodens Gruva are harmless. They give you leprosy as a present.
Thane Dyggve swung the first hammer in Dodens Gruva. Called lightning to split the rock.
The jarl's huscarls still patrol Dodens Gruva as phantoms.
Every realm had an old frontier dungeon and every one leads down to the Summoner's Hall.
The phantom huscarls gave crazy experience back in the day.
The lower floor of Dodens Gruva looks like Darkness Falls. Its actually Summoner's Hall.
Touch the bark of the grove gate on your way out or the forest forgets you. Sylvan custom.
Insidious Samn is out with the cniogcrag in the north east. 20.
Heard Moioch Fhearian looks just like the priestess of the grove. Do not say hi.
Heard the Domnann Druids cut their teaching branches off Bloinigein. It fights back.
Heard there are two leptus in Domnann and they both think they are the real one.
Heard Celendir is the only sylvanshade in Domnann that remembers its name.
The thralls broke their chains on the road to Mularn. Some are still out there.
The Thrall keeper never asks for a thrall back alive, only the chains.
Thorgil of Audliten lost his house to the Tomte, then his daughter.
Nisses lair door is in the south of East Svealand, the Tomte keep their chief down there.
The Dwarf dead in the hole of the dead lie down for a houses gift.
Dvalin is named for a Dwarf who went into the rock and did not come out.
Edigo and smack are the Tomte that went after Thorgil.
Snarls will not show himself until his snarlers are dead.
Svartmoln means black cloud. It is a bear by the Vasudheim bridge.
The thralls broke their chains on the Mularn road and never went back.
Emain Macha Macha is where the three realms meet. Alb and mid portal keeps are on the far ridges.
Macha raced the king's horses while pregnant and cursed the men of the kingdom, the songs say.
Crauchon soldiers say Macha cursed the field: whoever holds Emain Macha Macha is weaker than they think.
Fachan hop on one leg and look with one eye. Weird.
Midgard sends its young to kill Eresidae on the ridge north of Crauchon. Strange powers.
Do not go near the portal keeps. The guards are way too high.
Heard the master guardians at our portal keeps have not come home in years.
Heard Chieftain Hurbury holds a camp in Snowdonia and never asks for help.
The remnants iarn Dwarves fly griffons out of Faraheim. Only for friends.
The skogsra in Faraheim lead travellers off the path, like in gran's stories.
Faraheim's rockwall used to be the end of Aegir. The Morvalt broke it to reach Modernagrav.
Hagall was built in one season with Valkyn, Kobold and Troll guards on the gate.
The fallen Trolls in west Faraheim were trollheims once. They forgot the way home.
The frostbite wildlings say they were on Aegir before anyone. Probably true.
Goretooth and Shredclaw never meet. The day they do, run.
Minerva only flies you if the remnants like you. Kill their foes.
The cold lights by the Iarnwood border come out of the old one's shadow.
The Green Knight waits near castle Sauvage like he is expecting someone. I bet it is not us.
The Sauvage woodsmen say the forest is a beast lying down. The trees are its fur.
Castle Excalibur is a relic keep. The scabbard, supposedly.
Lord Mathius holds castle Sauvage. Every group heading north goes past him.
Brodecia has two heads so four eyes. Dugan wants them for a totem.
The fellwoods in Sauvage are deadwood that woke up.
The Gold Oaken Fellwood by Caer Renaris is older than the keep.
Heard the Mids and Hibs have the Green Knight on their weekly list too.
Heard the Green Knight is full again a minute after you give up on him.
Heard the Fallen Druid Seer by the standing stones keeps coming back.
The Sylvan call Olcasgean the root. Not a god. Just the root.
There is a voice at the bridge in Galladoria. It says intruders before you see anything.
When Olcasgean wakes he is two of him. Two trunks, one root.
Heard the realm raid wiped on the Broodmother and the special forces had to come in.
Nobody in Gotar puts to sea on a night the steersman is on the beach.
The undead scouts in the south east are what is left of an Albion army that kept marching.
Masrim is blind and hears everything in fort Atla.
Black Rixtas is the arachite the drowned ones will not go near.
Scout Argyle is from an Albion army that died here and kept marching.
Styrimathr Ygna was the steersman of the drowned ship. He comes ashore at night.
Mylings are ghosts of children left on the mountains, they ask to be carried.
A myling grows heavier every step you carry it.
The great mammoth herd of Aegir comes through mammoth valley.
The Old Matriarch leads the herd through the valley.
The Morvalt mammoth hunters camp above the valley, dellingstad wants them gone.
If a myling asks you to carry it, say yes.
The redcaps of Gripklosa dye their caps fresh every day.
Bothrar Hadd pays well for tusks.
The landflyke are Morvalt the other Morvalt threw out.
Clifton is the lammia town on Gwyddneau. Merchants, a stable, the lot.
The Clifton lammia only deal with you if you have not been killing their griffins.
The lammia say Gwyddneau was the hills of a drowned country. A drunk let the sea in.
The Lacula sept are lammia who hunt the dead. Blades not songs.
The north west of Gwyddneau is wall to wall ancient zombies.
Heard Cnieda buys ogre heads and nobody knows what she does with them.
Heard the Viking navigators on Gwyddneau will not fight, they just watch the stars.
Caer Benowyc is our keep on the wall. Lord Benowyc inside.
The cait sidhe are fairy cats as big as hounds. Even the Picts leave them alone.
The exiles on the wall were kicked out of every realm.
The templars camp by a ruined keep near the wall in the west.
Heard the cait sidhe are older than the wall.
Heard there is a spirit at the ruined keep near the wall the church wants laid.
Heard the Exiled commander trusts nobody, not even his own captains.
Lady Darra's four knights still keep her. Even dead.
The captains in the Hall of the Corrupt still bleed from cuts that never closed.
Lieutenant Meade wrote the men lost the will to fight. Then he got it too.
Captain Bardalph warned them about the Wizard. Nobody listened.
Heard the Archwizard is good for about two groups if you know the trick.
Heard the old guide said six groups is plenty for the whole hall.
Heard there is a new way down to the summoners now but the old hall is still down there.
Heard Darra's Paladins die first or she never does.
Heard Aidon is in both places. The hall and the Summoner's Hall.
The nine villages are a three by three grid. Meath is by the gate.
Meath has the consignment bankers. Sell stuff there.
The market explorer searches every consignment merchant in the valley.
Kilcullen and Broughshane both say the other copied its square.
The Elves raised the veil after quarrels with the Firbolg. The Lurikeens helped.
Heard the veil is thinner this year. More trumpets at Lough Gur.
Word is a Lurikeen in Tir na Nog says the Elves will come back through the veil one day.
Everything in the lair has black plague. Bring cures.
The animus in the lair were giants who came courting Iarnvidiur. She took their minds.
The Voluspa says east in the iron wood an old one breeds fenrir's kin. On Aegir she is real.
The iarn Dwarves call Iarnvidiur the old one. They do not say her name after dark.
Delegalt herds the animus like cattle. The animus were giants who came courting her.
The iarn Dwarves will not burn the iron trees. The smoke carries the plague.
The iarn Dwarves do not say her name after dark. Neither do I now.
She ports you into the water under the bridge. Climb the pillars.
The animus giants are what is left of the giants who came courting Iarnvidiur.
The redcaps in the Iarnwood run with the blood Reavers.
Iarnvidiur's servants walk the Iarnwood looking like anyone. The Dwarves trust nobody.
Chief Tarek has never left the wood, they say. Not once.
The spectral renders on Vasrem's hill were alive when he sat up. Probably.
The Inishail orcs stole Avalon books. Veena wants them back.
Toca reads stolen Avalonian tomes in the big hut, heard.
Inishail supposedly means isle of rest. The orcs disagree.
Heard Sarcondina was on Inishail before lord Emthoro.
The Isle of Glass is the bit of Avalon we kept. Caer Gothwaite is our capital in the Shrouded Isles.
Every the Shrouded Isles raid goes out from Caer Gothwaite and comes back to its chapel.
Heard Slor'vid only shows if you hit his lieutenants first.
Heard alluvian makes little globules until there is a dozen of them.
Heard Jocias hops into a damp skeleton when you kill him.
Heard Araich bows to Ariach. Drakoran do not bow.
Jamtland has four keeps because it has four roads that matter.
Hlidskialf Faste is named for Odin's high seat, you see furthest from its walls.
Jarl Hlidskialf took the keep's name rather than give it his.
Glenlock is the oldest keep in Jamtland, built to listen for the picks in Dodens Gruva.
The windswept wraiths are the worst of the frontier dead.
The Albion men in the Jamtland hills buy the red daggers roads.
Hagall the Red Dagger was a Jamtland Huscarl once.
Every road west out of Midgard goes through Jamtland.
The snowshoe bandits trade with the Albion leader.
Do not meet an old cockatrices eye in Jamtland.
The Albion leader has been in Jamtland so long he knows the bandits by name.
The Dodens Gruva road from Glenlock is grown over now.
Serk only hunts the far west, the healers of Vasudheim pay for its poison.
Jordheim was a village of heroes first. Relder Autansonn found the caves under it chasing a goat.
They buried the founder of Jordheim in his own longboat, rebuilt plank by plank down in the caves.
The whole city is built over it is dead. The Skalds mean that plainly.
Jordheim is the earth, so Jordheim is earth home. Home built on its own dead.
The high hall sits over the deepest cave, right over the founders longboat.
Kelgor and Bodgar have no Gothi in the halls, their houses came in with the Shrouded Isles.
Odin's statue on the height looks south over the city with one eye open.
The Realm Exchange Exchange always take an old shieldmaiden's name, the stair guards say.
Miri has had visions of Loki since the bowl last spilled. She hates them.
Audun will talk your ear off about the red daggers if you sit at his table.
The muryans in Keltoi Fogou were fairies once, my gran said. They got small.
Fane in Keltoi is undead, not Keltoi. The one the door did not give back.
Elder Gwern is the oldest Keltoi. The Cornwall Wizards want him dead.
Beven at the Keltoi door asks your name. Do not lie.
The Keltoi went underground when Rome came and never came back up.
Every Druid lot in Albion claims the Keltoi as ancestors.
The gremlins in Keltoi are whatever gets past the banishers.
Heard Fane in Keltoi is an initiate that never came out.
Heard Gwern knows what the fogou was built to keep in.
Heard the muryans were the first ones the fogou kept.
The Koalinth hold fights in their big cave. Wrestlers, bouncers, spectators.
The Koalinth Elder and castellan both slow your attack speed. Inflict suffering.
Two Koalinth diplomats in there. They say they came to talk.
The Master of Ceremonies runs the Koalinth fight cave. Wrestlers and bouncers.
The Horned Cave Toad is a pet. They feed it.
Shock slugs in Koalinth Caverns hurt. Do not ignore them.
Heard the Horned Cave Toad got loose once.
Heard the Koalinth diplomats say they came as envoys and the seal was a door slammed in their face.
Heard the Pelagian Alliant is just a big crab with a title.
Heard the Koalinth wrestlers rub the Horned Cave Toad's horn for luck.
Bysen means example in the old tongue. The bysen brothers are what every young ogre is told to be.
Llyn Barfog has an Afanc in it. Arthur dragged one out of that very lake, so they say.
